about: Golden set for the fictional bank policy assistant. `must` is the key value the answer has to contain, `docs`/`section` say where it lives, `evidence` is the exact corpus line (tests check it exists).

cases.q: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?
cases.evidence: Every full-time employee receives 22 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

cases.q: How many unused annual leave days can I carry over to next year?
cases.evidence: You may carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the next year.

cases.q: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
cases.evidence: A medical certificate is required when sick leave lasts longer than 3 consecutive days.

cases.q: How many weeks of parental leave does the primary caregiver receive?
cases.evidence: The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

cases.q: How many days per week must head office employees work from the office?
cases.evidence: Head office employees must work from the office at least 3 days per week.

cases.q: What are the core hours when every employee must be reachable?
cases.evidence: Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00, when every employee must be reachable.

cases.q: What is the maximum number of working days I may work from abroad?
cases.evidence: You may work from abroad for a maximum of 20 working days per calendar year.

cases.q: How much is the one-off home office allowance for new hybrid employees?
cases.evidence: New hybrid employees receive a one-off home office allowance of USD 400.

cases.q: Within how many days must expense claims be submitted?
cases.evidence: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the date of the expense.

cases.q: What is the meal limit per day for international travel?
cases.evidence: The meal limit is USD 85 per day for international travel.

cases.q: What is the hotel limit per night in listed capital cities?
cases.evidence: In listed capital cities the hotel limit is USD 240 per night.

cases.q: At what rate is private car mileage reimbursed per kilometre?
cases.evidence: Private car mileage is reimbursed at USD 0.45 per kilometre.

cases.q: How many characters long must passwords be?
cases.evidence: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

cases.q: How quickly must a lost or stolen device be reported to the Service Desk?
cases.evidence: A lost or stolen device must be reported to the Service Desk within 1 hour.

cases.q: How many data classification levels does the bank use?
cases.evidence: The bank uses 4 data classification levels: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted.

cases.q: How fast is the first response for a priority 1 incident?
cases.evidence: A priority 1 incident receives a first response within 15 minutes.

cases.q: How often are laptops replaced?
cases.evidence: Laptops are replaced every 4 years.

cases.q: What is the cash drawer limit for a teller?
cases.evidence: The cash drawer limit for a teller is USD 5,000.

cases.q: Within how many business days must a customer complaint be resolved?
cases.evidence: A customer complaint must be resolved within 15 business days.

cases.q: What are the branch opening hours on Saturdays?
cases.evidence: Branches are open from 09:00 to 12:30 on Saturdays.

cases.q: How much is the annual learning budget for each employee?
cases.evidence: Each employee has an annual learning budget of USD 1,500.

cases.q: What is the highest gift value I may accept from a client or supplier?
cases.evidence: You may accept a gift worth up to USD 75 from a client or supplier.

cases.q: How long is the probation period for new employees?
cases.evidence: The probation period is 6 months for all new employees.

cases.q: What percentage of salary does the bank contribute to the pension plan?
cases.evidence: The bank contributes 8% of your salary to the pension plan.

cases.q: And the secondary caregiver?

history.text: How many weeks of parental leave does the primary caregiver receive?
The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

cases.evidence: The secondary caregiver receives 4 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

cases.q: And for domestic travel?

history.text: What is the meal limit per day for international travel?
The meal limit is USD 85 per day for international travel.

cases.evidence: The meal limit is USD 60 per day for domestic travel.

cases.q: What about a priority 2 incident?

history.text: How fast is the first response for a priority 1 incident?
A priority 1 incident receives a first response within 15 minutes.

cases.evidence: A priority 2 incident receives a first response within 4 hours.
